items.marketingHeadline: Gourmet Kitchen, Jack & Jill Bath, and 3-Car Garage – The Eider Has It All!
items.marketingDescription:
OPEN HOUSE: 
Monday-Thursday & Saturday: 10am - 6pm | Friday & Sunday : 12pm - 6pm

Welcome to 8320 Golden Beach Court – A Beautifully Designed Single-Story Home Offering Space, Comfort, and Style

This thoughtfully crafted home blends spacious, open-concept living with timeless architectural charm — all on one convenient level. Perfect for entertaining or simply enjoying relaxed everyday living.

Key Features:

  • Formal dining room ideal for hosting guests or holiday meals

  • Versatile flex room that can serve as a home office, playroom, hobby space, or second living area

  • Open-concept kitchen featuring:

    • Oversized center island

    • Ample cabinetry and countertop space

    • Direct sightlines to the breakfast area and family room

  • Bright breakfast area with access to the rear patio for indoor-outdoor living

  • Large family room with vaulted ceilings, perfect for gathering or relaxing

  • Private primary suite includes:

    • Generously sized walk-in closet

    • Spa-like en suite bathroom with dual vanities and a walk-in shower

  • Two additional bedrooms, each with ample closet space and convenient access to a full bathroom

  • Convenient laundry room located near the garage entrance

  • Mudroom drop zone perfect for organizing everyday essentials

  • Spacious three-car garage with a two-bay and separate one-bay configuration for flexible parking and storage options

This home combines a smart, functional layout with beautiful finishes and single-level ease. Located in a desirable community, 8320 Golden Beach Court offers the space and style you’ve been looking for.

community.name: Biscayne Landing at Seaire
community.marketingHeadline: The Only Premier Builder in Seaire Offering Multi-Generational Suites on the Community's Largest Homesites
community.marketingDescription:
Welcome to Biscayne Landing at Seaire, a luxury single-family home neighborhood in Parrish, Florida. Designed for contemporary living, Biscayne Landing by DRB Homes offers beautifully crafted homes with seamless access to resort-style amenities. Whether you're looking for a peaceful retreat or an active lifestyle, Biscayne Landing delivers the perfect balance of both.

Just steps from Biscayne Landing is Seaire’s spectacular 4-acre Crystal Lagoon, a stunning destination for paddleboarding, relaxing on sandy shores, or enjoying a sunset stroll. Lagoon living brings a resort-style atmosphere to everyday life, where crystal-clear water and vibrant gathering spaces create a truly unique community experience.

Beyond the lagoon, Seaire offers amenities designed for daily enjoyment, including walking trails, golf cart paths, and planned commercial spaces that will introduce convenient shopping, dining, and services right within the community.

DRB Homes offers a collection of thoughtfully designed homes that blend coastal inspiration with modern functionality. Choose from one- and two-story floorplans featuring open-concept layouts, flexible multigenerational suites or lofts, and covered outdoor living spaces perfect for relaxing or entertaining.

Beyond the floorplan, homeowners can personalize their home with a wide range of designer finishes. Select from beautiful cabinetry, flooring, countertops, fixtures, and color palettes to create a space that reflects your individual taste and style.

Located near I-75, Biscayne Landing provides easy access to Bradenton, Sarasota, St. Petersburg, and Tampa, while beaches, parks, and nature preserves are just a short drive away.

DRB Homes is committed to delivering a seamless homebuying experience from your first visit to move-in day. Experience lagoon living for yourself at Biscayne Landing at Seaire by touring our professionally decorated model homes and exploring the community firsthand. Schedule your private appointment today!

community.name: Tides at River Marsh
community.salesOfficeHours: Sun-Mon 12pm-5pm | Tues-Wed 10am-5pm | Thurs-Fri: By Appointment Only | Sat 10am-5pm
community.marketingHeadline: The Only Riverfront Resort-Style Community Near Easton With Access to River Marsh Golf Club & Marina
community.marketingDescription:
Welcome to Tides at River Marsh by DRB Homes, where refined coastal living meets everyday convenience on Maryland’s Eastern Shore. Located beside River Marsh Golf Club and the Hyatt Regency Chesapeake Bay Golf Resort, Spa and Marina, and just moments from the Choptank River, this is Cambridge’s only resort-style golf and marina community offering single-family homes from the $400s.

Residents can walk to nearby grocery stores, coffee shops, and everyday retail, making daily life effortless. The marina and boat slips are just two minutes away, and the Hyatt’s spa, dining, and resort amenities are right next door. With Route 50 nearby, Annapolis, Easton, and Ocean City are easily accessible—yet life here remains relaxed, scenic, and connected to the water.

What truly sets DRB Homes apart at Tides is our exclusive level of personalization and structural distinction. We offer six thoughtfully designed single-family floor plans with coastal charm and the flexibility to customize your home to fit your lifestyle. DRB Homes is the only builder at Tides offering true personalization.

Our homes include a rare 4-foot conditioned crawl space providing substantial, usable storage—an uncommon feature in the area. Select plans offer an optional secondary ensuite in addition to the owner’s suite, ideal for guests or multigenerational living. High-end, aesthetically integrated fire suppression systems and full front and side irrigation come standard.

A low-maintenance HOA allows you to spend more time enjoying the pool, clubhouse, trails, and marina—and less time focused on upkeep.

More than a home, Tides at River Marsh offers a rare opportunity to own in Cambridge’s only resort-style golf and marina community — where DRB Homes stands as the only builder offering true personalization, distinctive structural advantages, and elevated coastal living.
